metadata.description: Model kernel manifest mapping AI models to gfx1250 Triton/Gluon/FlyDSL kernel shapes and sources

deepseek-v4-pro.model_attribution: DeepSeek V4-Pro grouped output LoRA (wo_a), TP=1, prefill token budget=16384

model_source.derivation: B=o_groups/TP=16; N=o_lora_rank=1024; K=(n_heads/TP)*head_dim/(o_groups/TP)=128*512/16=4096; M=16384 from prefill ubench.

kernels.label: DSV4-Pro wo_a BF16 BMM B16 M16384 N1024 K4096 token-major input/output
kernels.operation: Y[b] = X[b] @ W[b].T; X and Y are transposed views of contiguous [M,B,K] and [M,B,N] storage; W[B,N,K] contiguous

gluon.run_command: AITER_TRITON_ONLY=1 python3 -c "import torch; from aiter.ops.triton.gemm.batched.batched_gemm_bf16 import batched_gemm_bf16; torch.manual_seed(0); x=torch.randint(-3,4,(16384,16,4096),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(0,1); w=torch.randint(-3,4,(16,1024,4096),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16); y=torch.empty((16384,16,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(0,1); batched_gemm_bf16(x,w,bias=None,dtype=torch.bfloat16,YQ=y,backend='gluon',kernel_type='multicast'); torch.cuda.synchronize()"
gluon.benchmark_command: env -u TRITON_ALWAYS_COMPILE AITER_TRITON_ONLY=1 python3 -c "import torch; from aiter.ops.triton.gemm.batched.batched_gemm_bf16 import batched_gemm_bf16; torch.manual_seed(0); x=torch.randint(-3,4,(16384,16,4096),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(0,1); w=torch.randint(-3,4,(16,1024,4096),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16); y=torch.empty((16384,16,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(0,1); batched_gemm_bf16(x,w,bias=None,dtype=torch.bfloat16,YQ=y,backend='gluon',kernel_type='multicast'); torch.cuda.synchronize(); import triton; import triton.testing; fn=lambda: batched_gemm_bf16(x,w,bias=None,dtype=torch.bfloat16,YQ=y,backend='gluon',kernel_type='multicast'); ms=triton.testing.do_bench_cudagraph(fn,rep=20,return_mode='mean'); print({'us':ms*1000,'tflops':2199023255552/ms/1e9})"

notes: Run from the referenced AITER checkout with the selected Triton environment; commands call the public AITER API and require no corpus-specific runner or kernel overlay.
kernel_type=multicast is opt-in. AITER loads the tracked JSON configuration; tuning_config records its resolved values at source_commit.
The command preserves token-major input/output, contiguous batch-major weights, BF16 output, and no bias. The kernel uses TDM stores directly; no AITER_BATCHED_BF16_TDM_STORE override is required.
wave32 and num_warps=4 give four waves per CTA; the M/N cluster contains 4x4 CTAs. This is not a single-wave kernel.
On shared nodes acquire the official GPU lock before either command. Keep the source/config fixed when comparing compiler revisions.
benchmark_command preserves the historical seed-0 integer-input, fresh-process 20 ms cudagraph protocol. Run it in three fresh processes and report the median.
aiter_benchmark_command uses the native RotatingBufferBench and its input generator; its throughput is a separate protocol and must not be substituted for this performance baseline.

workload_characterization.basis: 2*B*M*N*K FLOPs divided by one BF16 read of X/W and one BF16 write of Y; ideal traffic estimate, not a measured bottleneck classification.

performance.hardware: MI450 gfx1250, d01-3 HIP device 0 (DRM card1), SPX/NPS1, 256 CUs; official shared GPU lock; own isolated container
performance.timing_scope: Median of three fresh-process 20 ms cudagraph mean measurements, one warm call before timing, fixed preallocated buffers, no cache flush; initialization, compilation and reference checks excluded.
performance.correctness: Full-output exact FP32 matmul rounded to BF16 for seed-0 integer inputs [-3,3] after each fresh-process measurement. Separate random-BF16 steady runs pass full-output finite checks and atol=rtol=0.01 before and after timing. All 17 multicast API correctness/guard tests pass.
performance.comparison: Use benchmark_command with the pinned AITER, Triton/LLVM and runtime on the same hardware. Clocks were not fixed or changed; 2500 W cap was observed. This short integer-input baseline is not sustained random-input throughput or an automatic regression threshold.

original_aiter_configuration.configuration: 128x128x128, four waves, three buffers, waves_per_eu=1, splitK=1, TDM_STORE=1
original_aiter_configuration.source: Same AITER checkout and compiler/runtime as the optimized measurement; original bandwidth_bound path with explicit historical configuration.

flydsl.configuration: Batch-stride adaptation of the referenced GEMM, one BMM launch; 256x256x128, two buffers, 2x2 waves, interleave=True, splitK=1, no M/N multicast; expert/coexec/post-misched LLVM hints enabled.
flydsl.scope: Same inputs, output strides, device, ROCm/Torch runtime and cudagraph timing as Gluon. Each DSL uses its own compiler backend. This is a local batch-stride adaptation of the pinned AITER TDM GEMM, not a measurement of FlyDSL's native BF16 BMM development branch (ROCm/FlyDSL@7bc8f138e9b3e284b60699471ed4072db39b58d3, kernels/bmm_gfx1250.py) or current main. The gain applies only to the stated tested implementation/configuration, not the best possible FlyDSL throughput.

random_input_steady_crosscheck.method: Seed-0 torch.randn BF16, same token-major strides; 32 calls/graph, approximately 3 s warmup, five approximately 1 s measurements per case, forward/reverse order; pooled median of ten samples.
random_input_steady_crosscheck.caveat: FlyDSL repeat medians span 2155-2302 TFLOPS and some no-cluster ablations are bimodal. Core-frequency changes were observed; their root cause is not isolated. Do not infer a fixed small performance gap from these runs.

literal_command_verification.result: Both committed run_command and benchmark_command execute without research helper imports. Source checksums match the five AITER commit files; compiled kernel entry point matches the manifest. Separate verification run, not part of the matched FlyDSL comparison.

historical_performance.hardware: MI450 gfx1250, d01-3 GPU 0, shared GPU lock
historical_performance.timing_scope: Mean of 10 graph replays using preallocated buffers; no cache flush; compilation, initialization and reference checks excluded.
historical_performance.correctness: Passed full-output exact comparison against FP32 matmul rounded to BF16 for integer inputs in [-3,3], including a post-timing check; not a general random-input accuracy claim.
historical_performance.comparison: Use gluon.benchmark_command with the same hardware/settings and timing method. Clock/power state and run-to-run variance were not recorded; this is a reference measurement, not an automatic regression threshold.
